issues.message: 缺少资料明确列出的对抗义，也缺少常用的方式义；agree with 等常见搭配不宜仅放在较少用义中。已补充相关核心义及各自至少两个例句。
“带有、具有”的讲解尚未覆盖附带成分及 with + 宾语 + 状态补语这一常用结构；with a smile 也更适合归入方式义。
释义同时提到工具、材料和方法，但例句只有工具。已将方式义另列，并补充材料例句。
with relief 仍是相同的 with 用法，不能作为原因义的反向表达；without relief 也不能普遍否定因情绪产生反应的因果关系。
原因义的句型说明应同时覆盖 shake with 等动词结构；be red with embarrassment 是常见搭配，不必标为固定表达。
原稿只在局部说明清音变体，却把结尾 th 一概讲成浊音；“旧标音”属于不必要的制作说明。应并列讲清 /wɪð/ 和 /wɪθ/，避免把读音变体限定为严格的地域或后接音规则。
两个阶段的 meaning 都是历史关系占位说明，并非阶段词义；材料也未明确给出中古英语字形。已将可靠历史关系保留在 summary，清空占位阶段。
Oxford 未提供实际正文，Cambridge 获取失败，不能作为已取得的内容依据。已仅对实际材料支持的内容关联维基词典，其余基于语言知识的讲解不挂这两个来源；推荐链接可保留。
词族完全留空过于保守。可补充常用复合词 without，说明真实拼写及现代含义，同时避免把词形分析冒充历史词源。

review.coverageAssessment: 已按实际英语词条核对陪伴、方式与工具、并肩或对抗，并逐句检查原稿。补丁补齐初中常用的方式义、对抗义和搭配对象用法，扩展附带成分与伴随状态结构；各核心义均有至少两个原创英中例句。读音、反向表达、来源关联及词源占位已修正。覆盖面以基础常用功能为范围，未扩展让步、任职所属等较高阶用法；现有材料不是完整义项词典。

senseInventory.assessment: 原稿已有两个自然例句，基本准确；保留并修正来源关联。

senseInventory.sense: 携带、具有特征、带有附加成分
senseInventory.assessment: 原稿覆盖携带和外观特征；补充饮品附带成分的例句。

senseInventory.sense: 伴随某种状态：with + 宾语 + 状态补语
senseInventory.assessment: 原稿只泛称状态，未实际讲解结构；补充灯亮着、闭着眼睛两个例句及句型。

senseInventory.sense: 工具、身体部位或材料；用、借助
senseInventory.assessment: 工具例句准确；补充材料例句，并与方式义分清。

senseInventory.sense: 动作的方式或表现；带着某种态度、表情
senseInventory.assessment: 原稿只有分散搭配，没有完整教学；补充独立核心义及两个例句。

senseInventory.sense: 情绪或身体反应的原因
senseInventory.assessment: 两个原例句均准确；修正句型概括与错误反向表达。

senseInventory.sense: 对抗、争执；与……交战或争论
senseInventory.assessment: 实际材料明确列出，原稿遗漏；补充两个例句，并解释 fight with 的并肩／对抗歧义。

senseInventory.sense: 常见搭配中引出态度、帮助或问题涉及的对象
senseInventory.assessment: 原稿仅在较少用义中提到态度搭配；提升为核心内容，补充满意、帮助和问题对象的具体例句。

{"id":"with-manner","title":"以……方式；带着……表情或态度","meaning":"说明动作怎样进行，或行动时表现出的态度、表情。","usageNote":"常用 with + 表示方式、态度或表现的名词，如 care、confidence、a smile。它与原因义有时接近，要看是在描述动作怎样进行，还是说明某种反应为什么发生。","examples":[{"id":"with-manner-ex1","senseId":"with-manner","en":"Please carry the glasses with care.","zh":"请小心搬运这些玻璃杯。","note":"with care 说明搬运的方式，相当于 carefully。"},{"id":"with-manner-ex2","senseId":"with-manner","en":"She answered my question with a smile.","zh":"她微笑着回答了我的问题。","note":"with a smile 说明回答时的表情。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"do something with care / confidence","zh":"小心地／自信地做某事","note":"care、confidence 是名词；整个 with 短语说明动作方式。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"with care","zh":"小心地","note":"常用于搬运、处理等动作。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"with a smile","zh":"微笑着","note":"常说明说话或行动时的表情。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"carefully","zh":"小心地","note":"可在许多动作语境中替换 with care；它是副词，不能据此替换所有 with 短语。"},{"en":"in a confident manner","zh":"以自信的方式","note":"可对应 with confidence，但更正式、较冗长。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"carelessly","zh":"粗心地；不小心地","note":"在搬运、处理物品等语境中可与 with care 对照，不是方式义 with 的通用反义词。"}],"similarNote":"近义表达要对应具体方式名词，不能把所有 with + 名词都换成副词。","contrastingNote":"反向关系来自具体的方式或态度，如小心与粗心，而非 with 本身。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-with-etymology"]}

{"id":"with-opposition","title":"与……对抗；和……争执","meaning":"在 fight、argue 等搭配中，引出交战、争吵或争论的另一方。","usageNote":"argue with someone 通常表示和某人争论；fight with someone 则可能表示与某人对抗，也可能表示与某人并肩作战，须结合上下文判断。需要明确时可用 fight against 或 fight alongside。","examples":[{"id":"with-opposition-ex1","senseId":"with-opposition","en":"The brothers fought with each other over the last cookie.","zh":"兄弟俩为最后一块饼干打了起来。","note":"over the last cookie 点明争端，with each other 表示双方互相对抗。"},{"id":"with-opposition-ex2","senseId":"with-opposition","en":"She argued with the shop assistant about the bill.","zh":"她就账单问题和店员争论了起来。","note":"with 引出争论的另一方，about 引出争论的话题。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"argue with someone about something","zh":"就某事和某人争论","note":"把争论对象和争论话题分清。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"fight with someone","zh":"与某人打斗；与某人并肩作战","note":"表达对抗还是合作取决于语境。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"argue with someone","zh":"和某人争论","note":"with 后接参与争论的另一方。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"against","zh":"反对；对抗","note":"在交战语境中，fight against 明确表示对抗；argue against an idea 则表示反驳观点，不能机械替换 argue with someone。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"alongside","zh":"与……并肩","note":"在 fight alongside someone 中明确表示并肩作战，与 fight against someone 形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"只有确定是对抗义时，fight with 才能按语境改为 fight against。","contrastingNote":"alongside 与对抗关系相对，但不是所有 with 用法的反义表达。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-with-etymology"]}

{"id":"with-agreement","title":"对……；涉及……（搭配中的对象）","meaning":"在常见动词或形容词搭配后，引出赞同、满意、帮助或问题涉及的对象。","usageNote":"整体记忆 agree with、be pleased with、help someone with something、have a problem with something。这里的 with 不一定表示陪伴，具体关系由整个搭配决定。","examples":[{"id":"with-agreement-ex1","senseId":"with-agreement","en":"I agree with your idea about the school garden.","zh":"我同意你关于校园花园的想法。","note":"agree with 引出赞同的观点；about the school garden 说明想法的主题。"},{"id":"with-agreement-ex2","senseId":"with-agreement","en":"The teacher was pleased with my homework.","zh":"老师对我的作业很满意。","note":"be pleased with 表示对某人或某事满意。"},{"id":"with-agreement-ex3","senseId":"with-agreement","en":"Dad helped me with my homework after dinner.","zh":"晚饭后，爸爸辅导了我做作业。","note":"help someone with something 引出帮助某人处理的事情。"},{"id":"with-agreement-ex4","senseId":"with-agreement","en":"We had a problem with the printer this morning.","zh":"今天早上我们的打印机出了问题。","note":"with the printer 说明问题涉及的设备。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"agree with someone / an idea","zh":"同意某人／某个想法","note":"with 引出赞同的对象；表示同意做某事通常用 agree to do something。","kind":"sentence-pattern"},{"en":"be pleased with someone / something","zh":"对某人／某事满意","note":"with 引出满意的对象。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"help someone with something","zh":"帮助某人处理某事","note":"with 后接要协助处理的事情。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"have a problem with something","zh":"某方面有问题；对某事有意见","note":"谈设备时常指设备出问题；谈安排或行为时也可能表示不接受，要看语境。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"approve of","zh":"赞同；认可","note":"在评价观点或行为时可与 agree with 意思接近，但 approve of 更强调认可，不能替换此处所有搭配。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"disagree with","zh":"不同意","note":"直接对应 agree with；disagree 的拼写是 dis- 加 agree，保留 agree 的完整拼写。"},{"en":"be dissatisfied with","zh":"对……不满意","note":"对应 be pleased with；不能当作 help with 或 have a problem with 的统一反向表达。"}],"similarNote":"本组展示的是不同搭配中的对象关系，没有一个近义介词可以统一替换 with。","contrastingNote":"反向表达由前面的动词或形容词决定，with 往往保留。"},"sourceIds":[]}
